description: This file defines repository classes for user and task entities in a database, providing CRUD operations, authentication, and validation logic using SQLAlchemy ORM. It encapsulates database interactions, handles exceptions, and promotes separation of concerns in a task management backend.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Handles user-related database operations such as creation, retrieval, and authentication.

classes.name: TaskRepository
classes.description: Manages task-related persistence, including creation, listing, updating, and deletion.

classes.name: RepositoryError
classes.description: Base exception class for repository errors.

classes.name: DuplicateEmailError
classes.description: Raised when attempting to create a user with an email that already exists.

methods.name: User create_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Creates a new user with hashed password, ensuring email uniqueness and input validation.

methods.name: Optional[User] get_by_email(self, db: Session, *, email: str)
methods.description: Fetches a user by email, normalizing input.

methods.name: Optional[User] authenticate(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Verifies user credentials and returns the user object if successful.

methods.name: Task create_task( self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, title: str, description: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Creates a new task associated with a user.

methods.name: Sequence[Task] list_tasks(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int)
methods.description: Lists all tasks for a specific user, ordered by creation date.

methods.name: Optional[Task] get_task(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, task_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific task by ID, ensuring it belongs to the specified user.

methods.name: Optional[Task] update_task( self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, task_id: int, title: Optional[str] = None, description: Optional[str] = None, is_completed: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Updates task fields with validation, restricted to task owner.

methods.name: bool delete_task(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, task_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a task if it belongs to the specified user.
